description_en: Queries the detailed information about a database account
description_zh: 获取指定数据库账户详情
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-database-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-i7m2d7zrw11 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-account-id 9 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDatabaseAccount

parameters.help_en:
The bastion host ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the bastion host ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the database account to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html operation to query the database account ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的数据库账户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_account_id

DatabaseAccount.description_en: The returned information about the database account
DatabaseAccount.description_zh: 查询到的数据库账号信息

DatabaseAccountName.description_en: The name of the database account

DatabaseSchema.description_en: The database name. A value is returned for this parameter if the database engine is PostgreSQL or Oracle
DatabaseSchema.description_zh: 数据库名。当数据库为Postgres和Oracle时，DatabaseSchema有返回值

HasPassword.description_en:
Indicates whether the database account has a password.
Valid values:

true

false
HasPassword.description_zh:
当前数据库账户是否设置了密码。
取值： true：已设置密码。 false：未设置密码

LoginAttribute.description_en:
The logon attribute. A value is returned for this parameter if the database engine is Oracle. Valid values:

SERVICENAME

SID
LoginAttribute.description_zh:
登录属性，Oracle类型数据库有返回值：
SERVICENAME
SID

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
